examples.text: te me ijjhiṃsu saṅkappā, yadattho pāvisiṃ kuṭiṃ, vijjāvimuttiṃ paccesaṃ, mān'ānusayam'ujjahan'ti.

13404.commentary: (MNa) na iñjantī'ti esikatthambho viya ṭhitattā na calanti.

examples.text: so gacchanto na satthiṃ unnāmeti, na satthiṃ onāmeti, na satthiṃ sannāmeti, na satthiṃ vināmeti. gacchato kho pana tassa bhoto gotamassa adharakāyo'va iñjati, na ca kāyabalena gacchati.
sataṃ sahassāni'pi dhuttakānaṃ, idh'āgatā tādisakā bhaveyyuṃ, lomaṃ na iñjāmi na santasāmi, na māra bhāyāmi tam'ekikā'pi.

13406.commentary: (SNPa) esā kāyassa iñjanā'ti sabbā'p'esā imass'eva saviññāṇakassa kāyassa iñjanā calanā phandanā, n'atth'ettha añño koci caranto vā pasārento vā, apica kho pana carāmī'ti citte uppajjante taṃsamuṭṭhānā vāyodhātu kāyaṃ pharati, ten'assa gantabbadis'ābhimukho abhinīhāro hoti, desantare rūp'antarapātubhāvo'ti attho.

examples.text: caraṃ vā yadi vā tiṭṭhaṃ, nisinno uda vā sayaṃ, samiñjeti pasāreti, esā kāyassa iñjanā.
carakā bahū bheravā bahū, atho ḍaṃsa-sarīsapā bahū, lomam'pi na tattha iñjaye, suññ'āgāragato mahāmuni.

13408.commentary: (DNa) nesaṃ lomā'pi iñjayun'ti tesaṃ vītarāgānaṃ lomāni'pi na cālayiṃsu. (DNt) nesaṃ lomam'pi iñjayuṃ tesaṃ lomamattam'pi na cālesuṃ, kuto antarāyakaraṇaṃ.

examples.text: mārasenā abhikkantā, te vijānātha bhikkhavo, te ca ātappam'akaruṃ, sutvā buddhassa sāsanaṃ, vītarāgehi pakkāmuṃ, nesaṃ lomā'pi iñjayuṃ.

13410.commentary: (ANa) iñjitan'ti rāg'iñjitaṃ dosa-moha-māna-diṭṭhi-kilesa-duccarit'iñjitan'ti imāni satta iñjitāni calitāni phanditāni.

examples.text: ākāse'va padaṃ n'atthi, samaṇo n'atthi bāhire, saṅkhārā sassatā n'atthi, n'atthi buddhānam'iñjitaṃ.
saṅkhāya lokasmi paro'parāni, yass'iñjitaṃ n'atthi kuhiñci loke, santo vidhūmo anīgho nirāso, atāri so jātijaran'ti brūmī'ti.

13412.commentary: (SNa) iñjitattaṃ vā phanditattaṃ vā'ti ubhayen'api calanam'eva kathitaṃ.

examples.text: passatha no tumhe, bhikkhave, etassa bhikkhuno kāyassa iñjitattaṃ vā phanditattaṃ vā'ti? yadā'pi mayaṃ, bhante, taṃ āyasmantaṃ passāma saṅghamajjhe vā nisinnaṃ ekaṃ vā raho nisinnaṃ, tadā'pi mayaṃ tassa āyasmato na passāma kāyassa iñjitattaṃ vā phanditattaṃ vā'ti.

13448.commentary: (SNa) iṇāyikā'ti yesaṃ anena hatthato iṇaṃ gahitaṃ. so kira kassaci hatthato ekaṃ kahāpaṇaṃ kassaci dve kassaci dasa… kassaci satan'ti evaṃ bahūnaṃ hatthato iṇaṃ aggahesi. te divā brāhmaṇaṃ apassantā gehato taṃ nikkhantam'eva gaṇhissāmā'ti balavapaccūse gantvā codenti. taṃ gahetvā imaṃ gātham'āha.

sītavātaparittāṇaṃ, hirikopīnachādanaṃ, matt'aṭṭhiyaṃ abhuñjiṃsu, santuṭṭhā itar'ītare.
appakā te manussesu, ye janā pāragāmino, ath'āyaṃ itarā pajā, tīram'ev'ānudhāvati.

vimokkhā'ti paccanīkadhammehi vimuttattā ārammaṇe ca adhimuttattā. atikkamma rūpe'ti rūp'āvacarajjhāne atikkamitvā, ye te vimokkhā atikkamma rūpe santā'ti padasambandho, itarathā hi atikkamma rūpe kiṃ karotī'ti na paññāyeyyuṃ.

13490.meaning1: winning debates; refuting ideology; (comm) freeing others from their faulty views
13490.commentary: (MNa) itivādappamokkh'ānisaṃsā cā'ti evaṃ vādapamokkh'ānisaṃsā, parehi sakavāde dose āropite taṃ dosaṃ evaṃ mocessāmā'ti iminā'va kāraṇena pariyāpuṇantī'ti attho. (SNa) itivādappamokkh'ānisaṃsan'ti evaṃ pucchā hoti, evaṃ vissajjanaṃ, evaṃ gahaṇaṃ, evaṃ nibbeṭhanan'ti iminā nayena itivādo hoti itivādappamokkho'ti etaṃ ānisaṃsaṃ.

examples.text: na'y'idaṃ, bhikkhave, brahmacariyaṃ vussati janakuhan'atthaṃ, na janalapan'atthaṃ, na lābhasakkārasilok'ānisaṃs'atthaṃ, na itivādappamokkha-ānisaṃs'atthaṃ, na iti maṃ jano jānātū'ti

13491.meaning1: purpose of winning debates; purpose of refuting ideology
13491.commentary: (MNa) itivādappamokkh'ānisaṃsā cā'ti evaṃ vādapamokkh'ānisaṃsā, parehi sakavāde dose āropite taṃ dosaṃ evaṃ mocessāmā'ti iminā'va kāraṇena pariyāpuṇantī'ti attho. (SNa) itivādappamokkh'ānisaṃsan'ti evaṃ pucchā hoti, evaṃ vissajjanaṃ, evaṃ gahaṇaṃ, evaṃ nibbeṭhanan'ti iminā nayena itivādo hoti itivādappamokkho'ti etaṃ ānisaṃsaṃ.

examples.text: te upārambh'ānisaṃsā c'eva dhammaṃ pariyāpuṇanti itivādappamokkh'ānisaṃsā ca. yassa c'atthāya dhammaṃ pariyāpuṇanti tañ'c'assa atthaṃ n'ānubhonti.
na'y'idaṃ, bhikkhave, brahmacariyaṃ vussati janakuhan'atthaṃ, na janalapan'atthaṃ, na lābhasakkārasilok'ānisaṃs'atthaṃ, na itivādappamokkh'ānisaṃs'atthaṃ, na iti maṃ jano jānātū'ti

13492.grammar: ind, adv, comp, acc sg of itivādappamokkhānisaṃsattha
13492.meaningLit: for the sake of unleashing the doctrine
13492.constructionSummary: iti + vāda + pamokkha + ānisaṃsa + attha + aṃ
13492.construction:
iti + vāda + pamokkha + ānisaṃsa + attha + aṃ
itivādappamokkhānisaṃsattha + aṃ
13492.commentary: (ANa) na itivādappamokkh'ānisaṃs'atthan'ti na tena tena kāraṇena katavād'ānisaṃs'atthaṃ, na vādassa pamokkh'ānisaṃs'atthaṃ.
13492.sanskrit: iti + vāda + pramokṣa + ānṛśaṃsa, anuśaṃsa (bsk) + artham

examples.text: na'y'idaṃ, bhikkhave, brahmacariyaṃ vussati janakuhan'atthaṃ, na janalapan'atthaṃ, na lābhasakkārasilok'ānisaṃs'atthaṃ, na itivādappamokkh'ānisaṃs'atthaṃ, na iti maṃ jano jānātū'ti.

13494.meaning1: Book 4 of the Khuddaka Nikāya; Quotations; Thus Said; one of the nine kinds of suttas
13494.meaning2: treatise of Suttas beginning with the phrase 'Thus it is said'

examples.text: suttaṃ geyyaṃ veyyākaraṇaṃ gāthā udānaṃ itivuttakaṃ jātakaṃ abbhutadhammaṃ vedallaṃ

tato paraṃ jātakaṃ, niddeso, paṭisambhidāmaggo, apadānaṃ, suttanipāto, khuddakapāṭho, dhammapadaṃ, udānaṃ, itivuttakaṃ, vimānavatthu, petavatthu, theragāthā, therīgāthā'ti imaṃ tantiṃ saṅgāyitvā khuddakagantho nām'āyan'ti ca vatvā abhidhammapiṭakasmiṃ'y'eva saṅgahaṃ āropayiṃsū'ti dīghabhāṇakā vadanti.

13496.meaning1: so they say; according to tradition; according to legend

examples.text: itiha te āyasmanto tena khaṇena tena muhuttena yāvabrahmalokā viditā ahesuṃ
itiha te ubho'pi mahānāgā aññam'aññassa subhāsitaṃ samanumodiṃsū'ti.

13497.meaning1: thus here; thus in this regard

examples.text: veditabbam'etaṃ, bhikkhave, bhikkhunā, abhāvitā me asubhasaññā, n'atthi me pubben'āparaṃ viseso, appattaṃ me bhāvanābalan'ti. it'iha tattha sampajāno hoti.
it'iha me, bhikkhave, paṭisañcikkhato app'ossukkatāya cittaṃ namati, no dhammadesanāya.

13498.commentary: (DNa) itiha te ubho ācariy'antevāsī'ti evaṃ te dve ācariy'antevāsikā.

examples.text: itiha te ubho ācariy'antevāsī aññam'aññassa ujuvipaccanīkavādā bhagavantaṃ piṭṭhito piṭṭhito anubandhā honti bhikkhusaṅghañ'ca.

13499.meaning1: I am thus; I am like this; this is my practice

examples.text: santo ca bhikkhu abhinibbut'atto, iti'han'ti sīlesu akatthamāno, tam'ariyadhammaṃ kusalā vadanti, yass'ussadā n'atthi kuhiñci loke.
